answer: A violet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the plume of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, slashed on a failed audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lantern of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
